title: Welcome to My Blog
content:
Welcome to my personal academic blog! Here I’ll share notes and insights on applied mathematics and machine learning.


Topics I’ll Cover
Numerical Analysis: Approximation theory, quasi-interpolation, sparse grids
Machine Learning: Flow matching, generative models, kernel methods
Mathematical Foundations: Gradient flows, optimization theory

Math SupportThis blog supports LaTeX math rendering. For example, the Euler-Lagrange equation:
$$\frac{\partial L}{\partial f} - \frac{d}{dx}\frac{\partial L}{\partial f’} = 0$$
Stay tuned for more posts!
